description: Reconcile two ledgers and list unmatched transactions
prompt: data/bank.csv and data/books.csv have columns id,amount,memo (header). Match rows that share the same id AND the same amount (amount is a decimal string). A bank row may match at most one books row and vice versa. Write unmatched.csv with columns side,id,amount,memo for every unmatched row, where side is `bank` or `books`. Sort by side ascending, then id ascending. Include a header row. Amounts in the output must match the source formatting exactly.
